subject: Literature
title: William Gibson's Neuromancer and Cyberpunk
description: One-minute skill: William Gibson's Neuromancer and Cyberpunk.

hook.text: William Gibson invented the word 'cyberspace' on a manual typewriter, having never used a personal computer.

buildup.text: Neuromancer imagines a future where hackers jack directly into a global network while megacorporations rule the world.

discovery.text: Gibson predicted that the internet would create a parallel reality where power, crime, and identity would all be virtual.

twist.text: When the real internet arrived, it looked eerily like Gibson's fiction: corporate, addictive, and borderless.

climax.text: Neuromancer launched cyberpunk and proved that dystopian fiction's greatest power is describing the present as future.

punchline.text: He imagined the internet before ever going online.

quiz.question: What remarkable fact surrounds Gibson coining the word 'cyberspace'?
options: He coined it while working as a computer programmer
He typed it on a manual typewriter, having never used a personal computer
He adapted it from an existing military term
